what: cây thông Noel (bách tán, Araucaria heterophylla), the Norfolk pine
uses: Plan 0026, R8: the row on the median of Quang Trung, the pines by Cảng vụ, at the south end of the park and along Hạ Long.

photos.author: trungydang
photos.shows: Cảng vụ Hàng hải Vũng Tàu (2 Quang Trung) from the junction of Hạ Long: two Norfolk pines by its corner as high as its fourth and fifth floors, scooters, Quang Trung to the north.

photos.author: trungydang
photos.shows: Quang Trung where it splits, to the north: the median with a row of Norfolk pines, low clipped bushes and a curb of red and white bands, a blue lamp pole with the frame of two arms at the top and a small lamp at half its height, the paved square of the park, Núi Lớn.

photos.author: quitle (Flickr)
photos.shows: Quang Trung at Tết 2019 from a moving car: the median is a lawn with a row of young Norfolk pines and a curb of red and white bands of about 1 m, with no hedge; balls of lights for Tết; the park and the sea behind.

photos.author: Tuong Lam Photos
photos.shows: From a drone over the south end of Bãi Trước, to the north: Khách sạn Bưu điện (12 storeys) with its pool, Cảng vụ, Quang Trung with the median of Norfolk pines and the curb of red and white bands, the square of the south end of the park with Norfolk pines and flags, the walk of the sea with the low wall, the boats of the bay, Núi Lớn.

photos.author: trungydang
photos.shows: The road of the side of the sea to the south, by the park: Norfolk pines and red hibiscus on the median, big Terminalia trees, a light blue kiosk with a red sign on the sidewalk of the park, stone benches, sculptures, scooters, blue lamp poles.

checks: Views: side, from under, far (100 m).
A straight trunk to the top, with flat tiers of five to seven branches every 0.7 m; the crown is a narrow cone, 4 m across at its widest.
The height of a grown tree is 14 m ± 2 m; the trees of the median of Quang Trung in 2019 are younger (photo 2).

envelope.width.how: Photo 0: the widest tier of the pines by Cảng vụ is about as wide as a bay of windows of its front (about 3.5 m): 3.5 m to 4 m.

envelope.depth.how: As the width: the tiers go round the trunk (photos 0, 4).

envelope.height.how: Photo 0: the two pines by the corner of Cảng vụ reach its fourth and fifth floors (storeys of about 3.5 m): 14 m and 16 m.

parts.trunk.sizes.diameter_bottom.how: Photo 2: a trunk on the median is about 0.3 times a red band of the curb (1 m) wide: 0.3 m for the grown trees by Cảng vụ.

parts.trunk.at.how: The base point of the model.

parts.trunk.color.how: Photos 1 and 2: a grey brown bark.

parts.tiers.sizes.first.how: Photo 2: the lowest branches of the trees of the median are at about 2.5 times the height of the curb bands' length: 2.5 m.
